entries.name: Dean River Classified Waters
entries.regs_verbatim: Dean River Classified Waters. All anglers are required to buy a Classified Waters Licence to fish the classified portions of the Dean River. There are no limits on the number of days which a Canadian resident may fish the classified sections of the Dean River. A Non-Resident Alien is allowed only one Classified Waters Licence for the Dean River, and may only fish one classified section of the Dean River for a maximum of 8 consecutive days per year regardless of whether guided or unguided. A non-guided Non-Resident Alien wishing to fish the Class I - Main Section of the Dean River, from Crag Creek to signs 500 m upstream the canyon, must enter an annual limited entry draw held each spring.

entries.name: Steelhead management changes
entries.regs_verbatim: Steelhead Management Changes. In response to declining abundance of Fraser Basin steelhead, steelhead fisheries within the Chilcotin River Watershed may be closed.

rules.verbatim: In response to declining abundance of Fraser Basin steelhead, steelhead fisheries within the Chilcotin River Watershed may be closed.
rules.review_reason: BOUND — watershed: the FWA basin of the Chilcotin (code 100-342455-) in Region 5. Conditional ('may be closed'). RECOVERED — absent from the corpus. User ruling 2026-10-01: steelhead rules bind STREAMS only — the province's only in the regions whose own tables name steelhead (1, 2, 3, 5, 6) — and never a lake unless the lake's own row mentions steelhead (big lake rainbow fall under the rainbow size quota, not the steelhead quota). The book prints this rule for the whole region. Bound to streams by `feature_types: [stream]` only — no `water`, so its competition key (and every stream answer) is unchanged.

entries.name: Trout and char daily quota
entries.regs_verbatim: Region 5 Daily Quotas. Trout/char: 5, but not more than 1 over 50 cm, 2 from streams, 1 Dolly Varden/bull trout, 2 lake trout. And you must release: ALL STEELHEAD, Lake trout, Oct 1-Nov 30, Bull trout (Dolly Varden) from streams, Aug 1-Oct 31.

rules.review_reason: User ruling 2026-10-01 (third): the wild-steelhead release binds STREAMS of the zone's own area (`feature_types: [stream]`, no `water`, so its competition key is unchanged) — 295c4ac3's reading of "lakes and streams" as every lake is reverted. A lake gets it only when its own row names steelhead.

User ruling 2026-10-02: a lake (or other non-stream water) a STEELHEAD ROW is written for or binds — by any rule of a water row that names steelhead, flags anadromous rainbow or prints the Steelhead Stamp — gets its region's zone steelhead release too (Tenas Lake, by the Atnarko/Bella Coola spring closure, gets Region 5's; Khartoum and Lois get Region 2's). The same line as trout_char_quota.r6, bound to the book-known steelhead LAKES (and wetlands) inside the zone's own area that trout_char_quota.r6 does not bind (op steelhead_waters: the reach builder's book-known set, never the curated steelhead list, within area:region:5, lakes and wetlands only — a stream piece answers to the zone it is homed in, which trout_char_quota.r6 already decides — minus trout_char_quota.r6's sections). A rule of its own because a non-area extent on trout_char_quota.r6 would rank it as a water rule on every stream it binds (`read.source_of`) and change its competition key; no `water`, as trout_char_quota.r6 has none.
